concerns.text: FR-010 is marked as '[deferred]' in the specification, yet the plan concretely fixes the hold‑out fraction to 20 % (e.g., “reserves a 20 % hold‑out set *before* any hyper‑parameter tuning” and “Hold‑out fraction = 20 %”). This contradicts the deferred placeholder requirement and should be replaced with a `[deferred]` marker until the exact split proportion is finalized.
